verdict: Organic activity held the period, but paid channels remain fully off.
narrative: All lead-generation this period came from organic sources — paid advertising ran at zero spend across both Meta and Google for the full 28 days, so no paid leads were generated. Your Google Business Profile drove 46 actions (29 direction requests, 17 website clicks), which shows real local interest finding you without ads. However, GBP engagement dropped sharply in the most recent week, and the last three days of the period recorded zero profile actions, a pattern being watched closely. With 173 website sessions and no recorded conversions over the 28 days, the priority is ensuring that the organic interest already arriving has a clear path to contact — that intake pathway is being addressed now.

website sessions recorded in the last 28 days, all arriving organically
paid ad spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day window
